text:
sasha: Nightly kernel-sieve prober flagged candidate 'kv-systolic-v2' as regressed at seqlen 2048 on H100. Trace link: https://ci.redwood/internal/1764999999 :eyes: Anybody else seeing a spike in p99?

perf-ci-bot: CI: nightly-probe job 1764999999 finished. Flakiness score: 0.12. Regression cluster: candidate-kernel-choices. Details: https://ci.redwood/internal/jobs/1764999999

mike: I pulled the perf dump — looks like L2 thrash + autotuner fallback to a smaller matmul tile. p99 jumped ~30%. quick top excerpt below.

mike: ```
# perf top (condensed)
cycles: 45% matmul-tiling-16
L2-loads: 32%
mem-bw spikes during KV refill windows
```

elaine: Is this only on H100? A100 baseline looks stable. Only difference I see is the KV cache invalidation pattern changes at seq=2048 (more mid-sequence rewrites). Could be eviction boundary effects. :thinking_face:

sasha: Command we ran:
```bash
./bench/probe --model=rwkv --kernel=kv-systolic-v2 --seq=2048 --batch=1 --iters=400 --arch=h100
```
Snippet from the harness logs:
```
KV hits: 77% -> 12% at seq 2048
avg latency: 2.1ms -> 2.8ms
throughput drop ~28% p99 shift
```

tj: Repro on perf-lab: I can reproduce but only when JIT schedule picks 'matmul-tiling-16'. Forcing 'tiling-32' returns perf to expected. Autotuner seems to misrank under this long-KV pressure.

mike: @tj can you drop the autotuner score dump? I suspect our cost model underestimates memory writebacks for long KV buffers (evictions + writebacks).

tj: Dump attached (excerpt):
```json
{"kernel":"kv-systolic-v2","score":0.71,"mem_est":0.64}
```
Score cutoff used in selection: 0.7

elaine: Proposal: 1) bump penalty for estimated mem writeback when estimated KV entries > 1e6 in the cost model; 2) add a microbenchmark that specifically stresses KV eviction/writeback to nightly suite so autotuner sees this pattern.

sasha: +1. Also add a fast PR CI gate: 50-iter probe at seq=2048 that fails the autotune candidate if p99 regresses >15%. And add a runtime fallback rule: if mem_est > 0.6 prefer tiling-32 variant. I'll open the PR. :memo:

dev-bot: sasha created PR #1187: "autotune: mem-penalty-and-pr-ci-kv-stress" — https://git.redwood/pulls/1187

perf-ci-bot: Noted. Nightly re-probe queued after PR merge. Will also mark candidate kv-systolic-v2 as quarantined until validation. :thumbsup:

sasha: Thanks team — assigning follow-ups: @tj add microbenchmark to harness, @mike update cost-model mem penalty, @elaine add fallback rule unit test. I'll coordinate PR review.

mike: I'll start a short branch with mem-penalty tweak and run the local sweep.

tj: I'll add the microprobe and a reproducer script for perf-lab (should be quick).

elaine: I'll write the fallback test.

sasha: Great. Filing an incident card for the regression group so we track postmortem if it leaks to prod.

perf-ci-bot: incident card created: INC-2026-0421-kernel-kv-regress
